[Benzinga news, 2026-10-23T22:02:09Z, by staff] Notice of Potential Settlement Payment for Brighthouse Life Insurance Policyholders
A legal notice has been issued regarding potential settlement payments available to individuals who have owned a Brighthouse life insurance policy.
A notification has been released regarding a potential settlement payment for individuals who have held a life insurance policy issued by Brighthouse. The notice informs policyholders that they may qualify for compensation related to their policy ownership. Further details regarding the eligibility criteria and the settlement process are directed toward those who have maintained such coverage. The announcement serves as a formal alert for potentially affected customers to review their eligibility for the settlement.
